j5create - 102w nano super charger for u.name: j5create - 102W Nano Super Charger for USB-C® 2-Port (GaNPower) With AC Extension Kits - Black
j5create - 102w nano super charger for u.description: Unleash the Power, Embrace the Portability: Introducing the 102W Nano Super Charger. Experience the future of power with our revolutionary 102W Nano Super Charger for USB-C™. Engineered with cutting- edge GaN technology, this compact powerhouse delivers lightning-fast charging in a remarkably small and lightweight design – your perfect companion for home, office, and beyond. Featuring dual USB-C® ports, you can power up multiple devices simultaneously. The integrated 100W USB-C® cable fuels your laptops and tablets at blazing speeds, while the additional 20W USB-C® port keeps your phones and accessories ready to go. Both ports support Power Delivery 3.0/2.0 for optimized charging efficiency. Adapt to your needs with the included AC extension kit. Seamlessly switch between a space-saving wall plug and a convenient desktop charger for ultimate flexibility wherever you work or play. Rest easy knowing your devices are protected. Our multi-layer safety system, including Over-Voltage (OVP), Over- Current (OCP), Short-Circuit (SCP), and Over-Temperature Protection (OTP), ensures worry-free charging every time. With fast, intelligent charging and comprehensive safety features, the 102W Nano Super Charger is the ideal companion for professionals, travelers, and everyday users.

j5create - usb-c multi-port hub with pow.description: Our USB-C Multi-Port Hub with Power Delivery provides extra connectivity for your computer. This pocket-sized multi-adapter with 2 USB 3.1 Type-A ports allow you to connect an external keyboard, mouse, or USB flash drive. With high-speed transmission up to 5 Gbps, data transfer is quick and easy. The HDMI port allows you to mirror or extend your screen and directly output 4K UHD @ 30 Hz or Full HD 1080p video to an HDTV, monitor, or projector. Equipped with a USB-C Power Delivery 3.0 charging port. It offers charging up to 60W when connected to a USB-C power adapter. The hub also provides direct access to your SD & microSD memory cards. The audio/mic combo jack allows you to connect your headphone set or speakers.
